messages:
Asha: Thanks for coming to today's all-hands. Quick follow-up on the org/headcount questions — happy to answer here. Ask away.
Priya: Can you share the headcount delta by org? engineering vs product? :eyes: 
Asha: Short answer: we're adding net +28 hires this fiscal year; ~+18 Engineering, +5 Product, +3 DX, +2 Security. Those are gated by budget approvals and will land in tranches.
Marco: To expand — Eng split is roughly: runtime (7), infra (4), platform (3), ML infra (2), SRE (2). These are target allocations not offers yet.
Jonah: Timeline for when reqs go live? Hiring team said they have capacity limits.
Lena: Recruiters are ramping. We're planning phased req postings over 6 weeks, with priority tags (urgent, Q2, Q3). We'll share the candidate pipeline dashboard tomorrow.
recruiter-bot: Openings dashboard: https://redwood.tools/hiring-dashboard :spiral_calendar: 
Priya: For teams affected by the reorg — will there be internal mobility guarantees or shadow posting windows?
Asha: We want internal candidates to have first sight. Policy: 72-hour internal window before external posting, except for high-priority critical roles (flagged by hiring manager).
Olga: What about manager/headcount changes? I heard some TL -> Manager conversions were paused.
Marco: We're pausing new manager headcount until we've run through the next round of org health check. Existing conversions will be evaluated case-by-case. TLs keep their current IC budgets for hiring unless approved.
Jonah: Any guidance for people who want to propose role changes or team merges?
Lena: File a short RFC in #eng-org-requests with 'org-change' tag. We'll triage weekly. Template link: https://redwood.docs/org-change-template
Priya: Will this rebalancing affect on-call rotations or SRE burnouts?
Marco: Short term: expect 1-2 month stretch in rotations. We're hiring SRE (2) prioritized and offering overtime compensation + temporary on-call backfill budget.
Asha: Final note — if you're impacted directly, managers will have 1:1s this week. If you have questions for leadership beyond this thread, DM me or drop into the follow-up office hours on Friday 3pm PST.
Priya: Thanks. :heart: 
Lena: I'll post the hiring cadence and the FAQ doc after this thread.
recruiter-bot: Reminder: submit referrals by next Thursday to qualify for Q2 fast-track.
